changes: The app now tells you when a new version is ready, with what changed and a Restart now button.
Menu > What's new lists every change, newest first.
Settings > The app > People who can sign in: each person's name and phone, filled in from Contacts with one tap.
Choosing people to share with now shows their name, email and phone.
Help has a search box, and each part of it sits in its own box.
Week's menu: an x on a planned meal takes it off the menu.
A star picks whose week's menu Today shows, also in Settings > Home screen.
Settings > Home screen: the Bluesky name box is back with its Bluesky words.
Something tapped on Today opens over it, so Back comes back to Today.
Today's Menu shows each meal like the Recipes list: photo, name, categories and times.
Week's menu: each meal shows like the Recipes list, without the tall gaps.
Diary: entries about someone other than you have a pale blue background.
Hold and slide replaces the up and down arrows everywhere.
My Stuff: a star picks which photo is the big one.
Today: the weather for wherever the phone is, with a link to the Met Office.
Recipes > Week's menu: plan breakfast, lunch and dinner, and share the menu.
Diary: + asks Appointment or To-do first.
Diary: a status on appointments (Completed, Missed, Delayed, On hold, Cancelled).
Diary: birthday cakes on the month view, and tap the month's name to jump through the year.
My Stuff: a clearer message when a Boat or Loyalty card cannot be saved yet.
My Stuff: the round red +, photo counts, and coming dates under each name.
My Stuff: lock private things like a passport or will with a password of your own.
My Stuff: new Boat and Loyalty card types, and Change the type.
Typing a date: a dd/mm/yyyy box, and tap the month's name to pick the year.
Contacts: one that is used elsewhere cannot be deleted, and Menu > Find double-ups blends two into one.
Wishlist: ideas in A to Z order, and Add it stays above the keyboard.
Web addresses and emails are no longer changed by the keyboard's autocorrect.
Recipes: the cooking timer now sounds on an iPhone.
New contact: a warning about a duplicate as soon as you type the name.
Contact searches put the name first, and a new contact with a name already there asks what to do.
My Stuff: Bought from, Insurer and services chosen from Contacts, and the first photo on each row.
My Stuff: a new tile for the things you own, with photos, PDFs, a service record and due dates.
Today: a party popper on someone's birthday.
Regular jobs: hold and slide to reorder.
Sent to you: look at a contact before accepting it.
Maps: an Our location button, and an x to empty the Find box.
